title: The Effect of the Hydroxyethyl Starch on Kidney Injury in Pediatric Cardiac Surgery
brief_summary: The investigator will evaluate the influence of colloid administration on postoperative acute kidney injury in pediatric patients undergoing cardiac surgery under cardiopulmonary bypass.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Children aged less than 7 years old
* American Society of Anesthesiology (ASA) physical status 1-3

Exclusion Criteria:

* Preoperative creatinine \> 1.5mg/dl
* History of dialysis
* Liver function abnormality
* Diabetes Mellitus
* History of allergic reaction
* Coagulation abnormality
